name: set_wifi
description: Turn the phone's Wi-Fi radio on or off. Wi-Fi is also called wireless or WLAN.

action.description: on to enable Wi-Fi, off to disable Wi-Fi

name: set_hotspot
description: Turn the phone's mobile hotspot on or off, so other devices can share this phone's internet. The hotspot is also called tethering or a personal hotspot, and switching to the hotspot means turning it on.

action.description: on to enable the hotspot, off to disable the hotspot

name: set_torch
description: Turn the phone's flashlight on or off. The flashlight is also called the torch, the light or the lamp.

action.description: on to switch the flashlight on, off to switch the flashlight off

name: send_sms
description: Open a text message to a person the user named, with the message body already written, ready for the user to send.

recipient.description: the name of the person or the phone number the user named as the recipient of the message

message.description: the words the user dictated for the message body, copied word for word from the request

name: dial_contact
description: Phone a person the user named, for example 'call mum'. The name is looked up in the user's own contacts, so no number is needed. This starts a call; it does not answer one.

recipient.description: the name of the person, or the phone number, the user wants to phone

name: read_messages
description: Read the user's recent text messages out loud, saying who each one is from.

count.description: how many messages to read, when the user names a number

name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder that alerts the user at a time the user names, for something the user has to do. A reminder appears as a notification with a short note on it. The user asks to be reminded.

when.description: the time phrase exactly as the user said it, for example 'at 5 PM' or 'tomorrow at 8:30'

text.description: what the reminder is about, copied word for word from the request

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm in the phone's clock app, for waking the user up. The user asks for an alarm or to be woken. An alarm rings loudly and has a snooze, and carries no note.

when.description: the time the alarm should ring, exactly as the user said it, for example 'at 6 am' or '7:30'

name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown timer that rings after a length of time the user names, for cooking or a short break.

duration.description: the length of the countdown exactly as the user said it, for example '10 minutes' or '1 hour 30 minutes'

name: set_volume
description: Change how loud the phone is: turn the sound up or down, set it to a level, mute it, or unmute it.

action.description: up or down to change the volume, set to use the level the user named, mute or unmute the phone

level.description: the percentage the user named, used only when the action is set

stream.description: which sound the user meant, when they said so, for example ringtone or music

name: open_app
description: Open or launch an app that is installed on the phone, named by the user.

app_name.description: the name of the app the user wants to open, copied from the request

name: open_settings
description: Open one of the phone's settings screens for the user to change by hand, such as Bluetooth settings or Accessibility settings.

panel.description: the settings screen the user asked for

name: navigate_to
description: Get directions to a place or address the user named, by opening the maps app.

place.description: the place or address the user wants directions to, copied from the request

mode.description: how the user wants to travel, when they said so

name: search_web
description: Look something up on the internet, such as a fact, the weather, a shop or a piece of news, by opening the user's browser with their search.

query.description: what the user wants to search for, copied from the request

name: answer_call
description: Pick up the call that is ringing right now, or hang up a call already in progress. This never phones anybody.

action.description: answer to pick the ringing call up, end to hang up the call

triggers: \b(answer the call|answer it|pick up the call|pick it up|hang up|end the call)\b
